title: Continuity between shots

body.text: When joining several shots, keep the
close so the clip looks like one story. The trick is to repeat the lighting/tone description in every prompt, like 'golden evening light, warm tone' in every shot.

example: End every prompt the same way: 'cinematic, warm golden hour lighting, film grain'

title: Plan before rendering

body.text: Sketch a short storyboard first — how many shots and what each one is — to save credits and time, because re-rendering has a cost. Planning beats guessing as you go.

example: Storyboard: 1) logo fades in 2) product spins 3) someone uses the product 4) closing text

question: What helps several shots look like one story?

options.text: Keeping color tone, lighting, and style close
It saves credits and time — no random rendering

question: What's the trick for lighting continuity?

options.text: Put the same lighting/tone description in every prompt
Let the AI randomize the lighting

question: What does planning shots in advance give you?

options.text: Lower re-render cost and organized work
